name: boost_learned
date_policy: S2 calendar date no later than S1 and at most two days earlier; time-of-day unavailable
uncertainty: sqrt(.25*(optical_mean-radar)^2+.5*optical_member_variance); radar std on fallback; not a confidence interval

selection.rule: max mean event-CV IoU among validation >= control-.002; tie lower CV Brier; control eligible
selection.note: CV is model-selection data; bootstrap over ten events is descriptive, not a new blind test
